Name: Bionic Prosthetics
Author: playfullgamer
Description: Lost a limb? Not a problem. 26 hand-crafted prosthetics that snap onto stumps, size themselves to the wearer and mirror their healthy limbs - from pirate peg legs and hooks to plasma arm cannons, tesla arms, drill arms, rocket legs and chrome cyber limbs. Full arms and legs bend at the elbow and knee, and modular upper arms and thighs take any forearm or lower-leg prosthetic. Most have a special ability on activate.
